title: About us
subtitle: Chaotic-AUR is a binary repository for Arch Linux, run by a team of volunteers who pre-build AUR packages.

buildInfrastructure.title: Build infrastructure
buildInfrastructure.sources: Most packages build automatically from their AUR source. Some exceptions live in our package repository.
buildInfrastructure.mainNode: The main node runs in Hetzner's Finnish datacenter on an EX44, with hardware from Garuda Linux.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.channels: For questions and support, use our issue trackers or the Telegram group. For private matters, pick one of these channels.
contact.issues: Open an issue for enhancements, database corruptions and other requests. Report build bugs to the AUR package maintainers.

mirrors.title: Mirrors

mirrorList.outro: shows every mirror and its status.

mirrors.syncthing: We distribute files with Syncthing.
mirrors.hostMirror: To host a mirror yourself, contact us through any of the channels above.

memorial.title: Memorial
